import HartshorneLib.Chapter4RationalDifferentialResidue

/-!
# Constant rescaling of a residue parameter

Rescaling a local parameter by a nonzero element of the coefficient field
does not change finite-pole or rational differential residues. This is a
characteristic-independent case of change of parameter; the arbitrary local-unit
case is proved in `Chapter4ResidueParameterChange`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry IsLocalRing

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

section LocalAlgebra

variable {k R : Type*} [Field k] [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
  [IsLocalRing R] [Algebra k R]
variable (c0 : R →ₗ[k] k)
  (hc0 : ∀ a : R, residue R (algebraMap k R (c0 a)) = residue R a)
  (t : R) (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (ht : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span {t})
  (s : R) (hs0 : s ≠ 0) (hs : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span {s})
  (c : k) (hscale : s = c • t)

include hscale

/-- Taylor remainders for parameters differing by a scalar have inverse
scalar weights. -/
theorem smul_localTaylorRemainder_of_parameter_eq_smul (a : R) :
    c • localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 s hs0 hs a =
      localTaylorRemainder c0 hc0 t ht0 ht a := by
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ ht0
  rw [mul_smul_comm, ← smul_mul_assoc, ← hscale,
    mul_localTaylorRemainder, mul_localTaylorRemainder]

/-- Taylor coefficients of order `n` have scalar weight `-n` under constant
rescaling of the specified local parameter. -/
theorem smul_localTaylorCoefficient_of_parameter_eq_smul (n : ℕ) (a : R) :
    c ^ n • localTaylorCoefficient c0 hc0 s hs0 hs n a =
      localTaylorCoefficient c0 hc0 t ht0 ht n a := by
  induction n generalizing a with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [localTaylorCoefficient_succ, pow_succ', mul_smul, ih,
      ← map_smul, smul_localTaylorRemainder_of_parameter_eq_smul
        c0 hc0 t ht0 ht s hs0 hs c hscale,
      localTaylorCoefficient_succ]

end LocalAlgebra

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]

omit [IsAlgClosed k] in
/-- Constant rescaling of the pole-clearing parameter scales the local
regular representative by the corresponding power. -/
theorem curvePoleLocalDifferential_of_parameter_eq_smul
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t s : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) (hs : Irreducible s)
    (c : k) (hscale : s = c • t) (n : ℕ)
    (ω : curvePoleDifferentials X x n) :
    curvePoleLocalDifferential X hx s hs n ω =
      c ^ n • curvePoleLocalDifferential X hx t ht n ω := by
  apply curveDifferentialMap_injective X x
  simp only [curvePoleLocalDifferential_map, LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower]
  rw [hscale, smul_pow, smul_assoc]

/-- The local differential frame scales by the same coefficient-field
scalar as its parameter. -/
theorem curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible_of_parameter_eq_smul
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t s : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) (hs : Irreducible s)
    (c : k) (hscale : s = c • t) (a : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) :
    curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx s hs a =
      c • curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx t ht a := by
  simp only [curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible_apply, hscale, Derivation.map_smul]
  exact smul_comm a c _

/-- Clearing a pole of order `n + 1` and then taking its differential
coordinate produces scalar weight `n` under constant rescaling. -/
theorem curvePoleDifferentialCoordinate_of_parameter_eq_smul
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t s : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) (hs : Irreducible s)
    (c : k) (hscale : s = c • t) (n : ℕ)
    (ω : curvePoleDifferentials X x (n + 1)) :
    (curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx s hs).symm
        (curvePoleLocalDifferential X hx s hs (n + 1) ω) =
      c ^ n • (curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx t ht).symm
        (curvePoleLocalDifferential X hx t ht (n + 1) ω) := by
  have hlin :
      curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx s hs
          (c ^ n • (curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx t ht).symm
            (curvePoleLocalDifferential X hx t ht (n + 1) ω)) =
        c ^ n • curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx s hs
          ((curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx t ht).symm
            (curvePoleLocalDifferential X hx t ht (n + 1) ω)) :=
    ((curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx s hs).restrictScalars k).map_smul _ _
  apply (curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible X hx s hs).injective
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hlin,
    curveStalkDifferentialEquivOfIrreducible_of_parameter_eq_smul X hx t s ht hs c hscale,
    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
    curvePoleLocalDifferential_of_parameter_eq_smul X hx t s ht hs c hscale]
  rw [pow_succ, mul_smul]

/-- Finite-pole residues are invariant under constant rescaling of the
specified parameter, in every characteristic. -/
theorem curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible_of_parameter_eq_smul
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t s : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) (hs : Irreducible s)
    (c : k) (hscale : s = c • t) (n : ℕ)
    (ω : curvePoleDifferentials X x (n + 1)) :
    curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible X hx s hs n ω =
      curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht n ω := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  simp only [curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible_apply,
    curvePoleDifferentialCoordinate_of_parameter_eq_smul X hx t s ht hs c hscale,
    map_smul]
  exact smul_localTaylorCoefficient_of_parameter_eq_smul
    (curveParameterConstantTerm X hx) (curveParameterConstantTerm_residue X hx)
    t ht.ne_zero ht.maximalIdeal_eq s hs.ne_zero hs.maximalIdeal_eq c hscale n _

/-- Rational differential residue is invariant under constant rescaling of
the specified local parameter. -/
theorem curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_of_parameter_eq_smul
    {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t s : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) (hs : Irreducible s)
    (c : k) (hscale : s = c • t) :
    curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible X hx s hs =
      curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible X hx t ht := by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro ω
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_mem_curvePoleDifferentials X hx ω
  have hω := curvePoleDifferentials_mono X (Nat.le_succ n) hn
  rw [curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_eq_higherPole X hx s hs n ⟨ω, hω⟩,
    curveRationalDifferentialResidueOfIrreducible_eq_higherPole X hx t ht n ⟨ω, hω⟩]
  exact curveHigherPoleResidueOfIrreducible_of_parameter_eq_smul
    X hx t s ht hs c hscale n ⟨ω, hω⟩

end
end Hartshorne
